WITH input_json AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS p
),
expected_columns(table_name, column_name) AS (

    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','workflow_run_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','idempotency_key'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','status'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','current_state'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','repository_full_name'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','current_phase'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','target_branch_name'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','pr_ref'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','pr_number'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','final_pr_head_sha'),

    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','locked_by'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','worker_execution_id'),

    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','lock_expires_at'),

    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','heartbeat_count'),

    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','next_retry_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','last_completed_step'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','github_branch_name'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','github_commit_sha'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','github_pr_url'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','updated_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','created_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events','event_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events','workflow_run_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events','previous_state'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events','new_state'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events','event_type'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events','event_payload_json'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events','created_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','workflow_run_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','step_name'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','status'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','attempt'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','input_hash'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','output_hash'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','started_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','completed_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','error_message'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','created_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','updated_at')
),
actual_columns AS (
  SELECT table_name, column_name
  FROM information_schema.columns
  WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema')
    AND table_name IN ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','moex_n8n_workflow_run_events','moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs')
),
missing_columns AS (
  SELECT e.table_name, e.column_name
  FROM expected_columns e
  LEFT JOIN actual_columns a
    ON a.table_name = e.table_name
   AND a.column_name = e.column_name
  WHERE a.column_name IS NULL
),
request_values AS (
  SELECT
    p,
    COALESCE((p->>'result_request_valid')::boolean, false) AS result_request_valid,
    p->>'request_identifier_kind' AS request_identifier_kind,
    p->>'workflow_run_id' AS workflow_run_id,
    p->>'idempotency_key' AS idempotency_key,
    p->>'repository_full_name' AS repository_full_name
  FROM input_json
),
selected_run AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(r) AS run_json
  FROM moex_n8n_workflow_runs r
  CROSS JOIN request_values q
  WHERE q.result_request_valid
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM missing_columns)
    AND to_jsonb(r)->>'repository_full_name' = q.repository_full_name
    AND (
      (q.request_identifier_kind = 'workflow_run_id' AND to_jsonb(r)->>'workflow_run_id' = q.workflow_run_id)
      OR
      (q.request_identifier_kind = 'idempotency_key' AND to_jsonb(r)->>'idempotency_key' = q.idempotency_key)
    )
  ORDER BY to_jsonb(r)->>'updated_at' DESC NULLS LAST, to_jsonb(r)->>'created_at' DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
),
events_raw AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(e) AS event_json
  FROM moex_n8n_workflow_run_events e
  CROSS JOIN selected_run sr
  WHERE to_jsonb(e)->>'workflow_run_id' = sr.run_json->>'workflow_run_id'
  ORDER BY to_jsonb(e)->>'created_at' ASC NULLS LAST, to_jsonb(e)->>'event_id' ASC NULLS LAST
),
steps_raw AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(s) AS step_json
  FROM moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs s
  CROSS JOIN selected_run sr
  WHERE to_jsonb(s)->>'workflow_run_id' = sr.run_json->>'workflow_run_id'
  ORDER BY to_jsonb(s)->>'created_at' ASC NULLS LAST, to_jsonb(s)->>'started_at' ASC NULLS LAST, to_jsonb(s)->>'step_name' ASC NULLS LAST
),
events_agg AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(event_json ORDER BY event_json->>'created_at', event_json->>'event_id'), '[]'::jsonb) AS events_json
  FROM events_raw
),
steps_agg AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(step_json ORDER BY step_json->>'created_at', step_json->>'started_at', step_json->>'step_name'), '[]'::jsonb) AS steps_json
  FROM steps_raw
)
SELECT
  (SELECT p FROM input_json) AS request_json,
  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM missing_columns) AS expected_columns_ok,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table_name', table_name, 'column_name', column_name) ORDER BY table_name, column_name) FROM missing_columns), '[]'::jsonb) AS missing_expected_columns,
  (SELECT run_json FROM selected_run) AS run_json,
  (SELECT events_json FROM events_agg) AS events_json,
  (SELECT steps_json FROM steps_agg) AS steps_json
